import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import ttk

class CalorieBurner:
    def __init__(self, root):
        self.root = root
        self.root.title("Calorie Burner")
        self.root.geometry("300x200")

        # Create a notebook with two tabs
        self.notebook = ttk.Notebook(self.root)
        self.notebook.pack(pady=10, expand=True)

        # Create a frame for the activity selection tab
        self.activity_frame = ttk.Frame(self.notebook)
        self.notebook.add(self.activity_frame, text="Select Activity")

        # Create a frame for the calorie burn tab
        self.calorie_frame = ttk.Frame(self.notebook)
        self.notebook.add(self.calorie_frame, text="Calorie Burn")

        # Create a listbox to display activities
        self.activities = ["Walking", "Jogging", "Cycling", "Swimming"]
        self.activity_listbox = tk.Listbox(self.activity_frame)
        self.activity_listbox.pack(pady=10)

        # Create a button to add custom activities
        self.add_activity_button = ttk.Button(self.activity_frame, text="Add Custom Activity")
        self.add_activity_button.pack(pady=10)

        # Create a label to display the selected activity
        self.selected_activity_label = ttk.Label(self.calorie_frame, text="")
        self.selected_activity_label.pack(pady=10)

        # Create a label to display the calorie burn
        self.calorie_burn_label = ttk.Label(self.calorie_frame, text="")
        self.calorie_burn_label.pack(pady=10)

        # Create a button to calculate calorie burn
        self.calculate_button = ttk.Button(self.calorie_frame, text="Calculate Calorie Burn")
        self.calculate_button.pack(pady=10)

        # Populate the listbox with activities
        for activity in self.activities:
            self.activity_listbox.insert(tk.END, activity)

        # Bind the listbox selection to the selected activity label
        self.activity_listbox.selection_set(0)
        self.activity_listbox.bind("<<ListboxSelect>>", self.update_selected_activity)

        # Bind the calculate button to the calorie burn calculation
        self.calculate_button.bind("<Button-1>", self.calculate_calorie_burn)

    def update_selected_activity(self, event):
        # Get the selected activity from the listbox
        selected_activity = self.activity_listbox.get(self.activity_listbox.curselection())

        # Update the selected activity label
        self.selected_activity_label.config(text=selected_activity)

    def calculate_calorie_burn(self, event):
        # Get the selected activity from the selected activity label
        selected_activity = self.selected_activity_label.cget("text")

        # Calculate the calorie burn based on the selected activity
        if selected_activity == "Walking":
            calorie_burn = 4.5
        elif selected_activity == "Jogging":
            calorie_burn = 7.5
        elif selected_activity == "Cycling":
            calorie_burn = 8.5
        elif selected_activity == "Swimming":
            calorie_burn = 6.5
        else:
            calorie_burn = 0

        # Update the calorie burn label
        self.calorie_burn_label.config(text=f"Calorie Burn: {calorie_burn}")

root = tk.Tk()
app = CalorieBurner(root)
root.mainloop()
```

The application allows users to select an activity from a listbox and calculate the calorie burn based on the selected activity. However, this is a simplified implementation and may require additional features and functionality to meet the requirements of a real-world application.
